title: Polly can draw the answer
summary:
Polly learned to draw charts, the community catalog reached 802 apps, and a long list of audio, video and chat edge cases got less interesting.

Polly gained a `render_visual` tool for attaching tables and charts to Discord replies. It supports multiple visuals in one reply, with better table formatting and a fallback to raw markdown if rendering fails. A separate change keeps an unavailable tool out of Polly's API mode.

Fifteen community apps joined the catalog, spanning image makers, study tools, chat assistants, a resume builder and an n8n node for image and video generation. Agent-maintained catalog updates also removed four dead listings, so the showcase has fewer trips to a 404.

WAV speech responses now carry correct file sizes, and Whisper transcription handles text and subtitle response formats. Grok video honors `aspectRatio` without explicit dimensions; the Playground also clears incompatible TTS voice selections. Text-request fixes address Grok conversation annotations, non-reasoning Grok options and streaming options rejected by non-OpenAI Azure models. Model metadata and audio request handling received smaller corrections.

daily.title: Charts in Polly replies
daily.text: Polly can attach tables and charts directly to Discord replies, including bar, line, scatter, pie and heatmap charts. One reply can contain multiple visuals.

daily.title: More shared UI components
daily.text: The React UI package adds reusable dialogs, dropdowns, sliders, tables, alerts and wallet displays for building Pollinations-powered interfaces. [Explore the React UI](https://react.pollinations.ai).
